annotation.title_clean: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.title_en: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pandemic Preparedness Partnership (report to the G7, UK Presidency)
annotation.summary_en: Independent report by the Pandemic Preparedness Partnership to the G7 (June 2021) proposing a 100 Days Mission: making diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines available within 100 days of a pandemic threat. It gives a roadmap on R&D, best practice between pandemics, and rules for prioritisation, speed and equitable access. Unrelated to AI or robotics, despite the AI for Science Strategy title metadata.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aim for safe, effective, affordable diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines within 100 days of a WHO PHEIC declaration.
Prioritise R&D on critical viral families and maintain a diversity of vaccine platforms.
Embed best practice between pandemics, including manufacturing, clinical trial networks and financing readiness.
Agree 'rules of the road' on prioritisation, speed and equitable access for a pandemic.
Make governments, industry and international organisations jointly responsible for implementation.
